type: exact rational rank-5 affine obstruction and rank-6 actuator certificate

cells.scope: Exact Fraction first jet of the finite-decimal CSV coordinates, supplied fixed face ledger, oriented-volume centroid, and explicitly listed zero-equivalent rational wall functions.

control_convention.linear_3_to_7: trace-free symmetric generators diag(1,0,-1), xy, xz, diag(0,1,-1), yz
control_convention.sixth_actuator: row54 along n_base x (q1-q0), an exact base-plane tangent

exact_local_affine_certificate.conclusion: No increment in the explicit five-control first jet solves all six affine wall equations.

exact_sixth_actuator_rank_lift.conclusion: The row54 base-tangent actuator removes the exact first-order rank defect. This is not, by itself, a nonlinear shared-event witness.

exact_trust_box_inequality_farkas.conclusion: The listed necessary linearized inequalities are infeasible in the stated trust box, because lambda is strictly positive, lambda^T*A=0, and lambda^T*b<0.
